material_events.claim: Griffon completed a private placement notes offering of $800 million aggregate principal amount of 6.25% senior notes due 2034, with net proceeds of approximately $792 million, to redeem its outstanding 5.75% Senior Notes due 2028 and pay related fees.
quotes: On August 18, 2026, Griffon Corporation (the "Company") completed its previously announced notes offering (the "Notes Offering") of $800 million aggregate principal amount of 6.25% senior notes due 2034 (the "Notes").
The net proceeds to the Company from the Notes Offering were approximately $792 million.

Griffon intends to use the proceeds from the offering, together with cash on hand and revolver borrowings under either Griffon's existing credit facility or its new revolving credit facility that is expected to close substantially concurrently with the offering, to (i) redeem all of Griffon's outstanding 5.75% Senior Notes due 2028 (the "2028 Notes") at the applicable redemption price plus accrued and unpaid interest and (ii) pay certain related fees and expenses.
